title: Sunday · the Rain, 2018
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Twenty-first January. The mudflats. The pup's first Rain out on the flats: he doesn't mind rain. The first dog minded.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the flats in rain from the bluff. A man and a small dog far out, the dog running.

image.prompt: mudflats in January rain from a bluff, a man far out with a small three-legged dog running ahead of him, gray watercolor, no words

panels.name: Running

panels.composition: Tier 2: the pup, soaked, delighted, in a channel.

image.prompt: a soaked three-legged dog standing delighted in a shallow channel of rainwater on mudflats, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Channel

panels.composition: Tier 3: the drift log. The man sitting. The pup shaking off beside him, a burst of drops. The rain, held. He's laughing; you can tell from the shoulders.

image.prompt: a man on a bleached drift log in the rain with his shoulders shaking in a laugh as a small dog shakes itself off in a burst of drops beside him, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Shaking off

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: The pup doesn't mind rain. Wood laughs; the strip shows his shoulders.
